title: Is this house in mall world?
content: I saw a video on YouTube about mall world and she showed a comment about a ever changing house. So I wanted to see if what I call "The Infinity House" is part of this. So this is a cabin located in a clearing in the forest. It's old and run down but looks eerily clean like nothing can possibly be that clean there are rooms apon rooms with pathways and secrets there is the wooden white room that looks like triangular with lots of shelves. The giant teal bathroom with a circular pool sized tub and a red room with a heart bed. It's been a while since I have seen it so the details are a little fuzzy. But I am always drawn to/ forced toward the water heater room. A small messy room barely big enough to fit in and in the room there is a floor hatch that leads to this cave system that i always get lost in i can go 10 ft and cant find my way out again. This probably makes no sense but I have been thinking about this place a lot lately.
